prompts.brandAvatarPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square official game avatar/app icon for the Russian fantasy browser game «Герои Эфира».
Create a finished 1024x1024 square bitmap, full bleed, no text. Match the game's canonical illustrated human avatars visible in the conversation: hand-painted polished fantasy portrait, softly modelled believable anatomy, detailed wavy chestnut hair, clear green eyes, confident masculine face, warm natural skin, rich but controlled highlights. A handsome adult human woodland hero in a deep green cloak and dark teal leather armour with a small elegant gold clasp. Head and upper shoulders fill the composition; face upright, centred, looking towards viewer, anatomically normal neck. Subtle confident smile. Behind him: deep sapphire-to-teal magical atmosphere, a single refined luminous gold circular arena rim and faint distant fantasy architecture. Three small golden Ether droplets at the lower edge as a secondary emblem, not obscuring the face.
Composition must remain excellent when cropped into a circle: face and important details within central 70%, no cut off crown of hair, all shoulders comfortably framed. Genuine circle, not ellipse; restrained rim, no bulky outer frame. High-end painterly fantasy game art, clean crisp edges, not a photograph, not plastic toy rendering, no anime eyes, no animals, no cartoon infantilisation, no sparkles over face, no text, no letters, no watermark. Strong recognisable silhouette at 64px. Full artwork, not a presentation board or mockup.
